creature_fields.name: MaxAngleChangeRaw
creature_fields.note: 2048 angular units per full turn. Per-tick limit = floor(raw / simulationTPS); positive raw clamped to at least 1. Degrees per second before quantization = raw*360/2048. Not signed /4096.

creature_fields.name: GameExtraFlagsRaw
creature_fields.note: Runtime +0x68A. Game converter reads this slot for both measured strides. Do not auto-copy the editor slot.

creature_fields.name: EditorExtraFlagsRaw
creature_fields.note: Only present in 5537-byte variant. Separate from GameExtraFlagsRaw.

creature_fields.name: WidthRaw
creature_fields.note: Raw fixed-point width; loader stores low16 in runtime+0x63A. Consumers use width>>1; 0x48F690 adds clearance 0x80. Not an independently stored radius.

creature_fields.name: MassRaw
creature_fields.note: Loader stores low16 in runtime+0x624. Collision helper uses (mass>>12) as a 1..5 class in a 5x5 lookup; fractional bits do not affect that lookup. No bounds clamp in helper.

creature_fields.name: AirFrictionRaw
creature_fields.note: Low16 copied into runtime+0x690 and instance+0x11E at initialization; full physical interpretation not proven.

creature_fields.name: ScoreRatingRaw
creature_fields.note: Runtime+0x787 u8. 0x4BCB20 sums values over a creature list; 0x4FA8D0 compares candidates to select a minimum. Full AI strategy semantics are not inferred.

creature_fields.name: RoomCapacityNeededRaw
creature_fields.note: Runtime+0x672 u8. Room routine 0x4E69B0 subtracts this amount for processed occupants; zero skips that subtraction path.

creature_fields.name: DisarmFailurePercentageRaw
creature_fields.confidence: failure threshold and RNG bound confirmed
creature_fields.note: Runtime+0x5E0 u8, stat20 growth. Disarm routine compares random(100), range0..99, against level-scaled threshold; grown threshold clamped0..254. Values>=100 always enter the compared branch.

creature_fields.name: SatisfyAngerTreatRaw
creature_fields.confidence: unsigned consumer and gift IDs confirmed
creature_fields.note: Runtime+0x6E1 read as u16; gold IDs1..3 / Chicken ID9 gift branches call mood handler category5 with negative of this value. Emotionless bit4 suppresses the inspected handler.

creature_fields.name: ScaleRaw
creature_fields.confidence: storage read confirmed; semantic name from template
creature_fields.note: Raw integer view. Signedness, displayed scale and full gameplay semantics not inferred from memcpy.

creature_fields.name: SniperZoomMultiplierRaw
creature_fields.note: Runtime+0x79B u32. 0x40FDF0 uses raw>>12, returns when result<2, and multiplies an ability range parameter by that integer in one toggle branch. Fractions are discarded; this is not proof of continuous camera zoom.

creature_fields.name: AbilityCreepPercentageRaw
creature_fields.confidence: runtime consumer confirmed; source names qualified
creature_fields.note: Runtime+0x760 used under instance flag0x1000; level-scaled by stat26, then multiplies a squared-distance quantity /100 in both inspected consumers. Do not present as ordinary movement speed.

creature_fields.name: SwipeSpeedRaw
creature_fields.confidence: UI use and divide constraint confirmed
creature_fields.note: Runtime+0x791 u16 passed with swipe ID to0x5075A0. Nonzero swipe computes22000/speed; IDIV0 at0x507615 when speed=0. Both current catalogues store75 for all46 creatures.

creature_fields.name: WorkModifierDefaultRaw
creature_fields.note: Copied to type+0x793, but normal instance constructor sets work modifier+0x3AF to literal0xCCC (~0.8), independently of this field. No universal unused claim.

creature_fields.name: WorkModifierLevelIncreaseRaw
creature_fields.note: Type+0x797 getter 0x48B330 feeds addition to instance+0x3AF in 0x48B120. Current two catalogues contain zero for all46 creatures.

creature_arrays.name: FootstepFrames
creature_arrays.note: Runtime data +0x7A3: pairs per animation slot. Instance phases = floor(frame*4096 / loadedAnimationFrameCount).
